lines:
Responsibilities: Redeems only invocation-scoped lease handles over the authenticated host-generation channel, materializes the minimum permitted fields into declared headers, environment variables, stdin, protected temporary files, or sidecar channels, and supplies a RedactionSetV1 to every diagnostic/result path. It revokes and zeroizes material on terminal, cancellation, timeout, uncertainty, or generation loss.
Owned runtime state: in-memory SecretMaterializationV1 bound to decisionId, invocationId, audience, process generation, field allowlist, expiry, use count, injection target, redaction fingerprints, and cleanup status. Credential values are never persisted and non-recoverable leases are not cached across restart.
Versioned ports and contracts: SecretLeaseHandleV1, RedeemLeaseV1, SecretMaterializationPlanV1, SecretDeliveryV1, RedactionSetV1, LeaseUseAuditV1, RevokeLeaseV1, and ZeroizationEvidenceV1. The core secret broker remains the only issuer and may deny any redemption.
Failure and degraded behavior: expired/revoked/mismatched audience, field, invocation, or generation fails closed before disclosure. Partial injection cleans all material; after a secret-bearing request may have started, transport ambiguity is passed to outcome classification rather than guessed.
Security truthfulness: no access outside lease fields or lifetime, no secret values in Aworkit DTOs/logs/artifacts/crash diagnostics. Redaction cannot prevent enabled trusted plugin code from independently reading/retaining user-accessible data or bypassing brokers, and the design states that limit.
Observability, performance, and cross-platform behavior: metadata-only issue/redeem/revoke/zeroize audit, redaction-leak fixtures, bounded TTL/use counts, constant-time token checks, memory zeroization, and protected environment/temp-file/pipe implementations for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Non-responsibilities: no credential storage, lease issuance, authority/approval, provider authentication policy, canonical audit commit, portable credential sync, or plugin sandboxing.

data.name: Invocation Secret Lease Materializer & Redactor
data.technology: Rust memory-hardened lease client and streaming redaction filters
